brief.aiHintMemoAnalysis: AI will parse the booking note to extract concerns, expectations, and tone, surfacing a short pre-session summary of what to watch for (Anthony wires the nightly batch job).

brief.aiHintLastProduct: AI will pull the last product or service proposed and how the customer responded (purchased / considering / declined-phrasing) to inform today's recommendation strategy.
brief.aiHintRecommendedFocus: Based on karute history, product reactions, seasonal factors, and salon goals, AI will suggest the focus angle for today's session — deeper questions, product to propose, care direction.

header.title: Coaching

monthlyGrowth.title: This month's growth

learnFromTop.title: Learn from top performers
learnFromTop.subtitle: Anonymized team-shared data (Layer 2)

learnFromTop.emptyHint: AI-extracted patterns from the salon's top performers surface here, anonymized + ready to apply in today's session. Lights up when Anthony wires the pattern-extraction pipeline.

strengths.title: Your strengths

strengths.emptyHint: AI analyzes your past sessions and surfaces your strongest categories + conversation patterns here. Lights up when Anthony wires growth-data retrieval.

nextFocus.title: Next focus

coaching.title: Coaching settings
coaching.intro: Feature that analyzes session conversations and gives staff growth-oriented feedback (Phase 3 planned). Settings are scaffolded here so they're ready when the feature ships.
coaching.masterEnableDesc: Enable coaching for the whole store. Individual staff consent is still required.
coaching.weightsDesc: Weight per metric for top-performer ranking (sums to 100%). Determines what AI-extracted patterns the system learns from.
coaching.minSessionsDesc: Minimum sessions required to rank as a top performer. Filters out noise from low-data members.
coaching.autoDeclineDesc: If a coaching suggestion is not actioned within this many days, it's auto-rejected.
coaching.policyDesc: The text shown to staff at consent time. Spells out how conversation data is handled + what's shared with owners.
coaching.consentStatusDesc: Current consent state for each staff member. Only the staff themselves can revoke.
coaching.crossStaffNamesDesc: Display other staff members' names in coaching dashboards. Turn off for anonymized view.
coaching.label: Coaching
coaching.phaseBanner: Coaching ships in Phase 3. These settings are scaffolded so they're ready the moment the feature lights up. Sliders + toggles are interactive for preview purposes; values are NOT yet persisted.
coaching.crossStaffReservation: Show other staff's customer names in reservation + customer list
coaching.crossStaffReservationDesc: When off, staff viewing OTHER staff's reservations or customer list see only time + service type — names are hidden. Owners + managers always see full info.
coaching.crossStaffKarute: Show other staff's customer names in karute
coaching.crossStaffKaruteDesc: Karute is often viewed by staff covering someone else's customer, so this defaults ON. Turn off only if your store's privacy policy requires stricter scoping.
coaching.weightsHelper: Weights the AI uses when identifying top performers. Set so the total equals 100%.
coaching.minSessionsRowDesc: Until a staff member hits this session count, the AI will NOT analyze growth areas for them. Safety guard against drawing conclusions from too little data.
coaching.provisionalKaruteRowLabel: Days before an unresolved provisional karute auto-declines
coaching.provisionalKaruteRowDesc: If a first-session 'provisional karute' isn't resolved (closed-won or closed-lost) within this many days, it's auto-saved as declined. Declined karute is kept for AI coaching training data but hidden from the customer list.
coaching.policyHelper: Text shown to staff in the consent dialog. Have legal review it before use.
coaching.policyDefault: Coaching analyzes session conversations to give you growth-oriented feedback. Individual conversation details are visible only to you; owners + managers see category-level aggregates only.
coaching.consentStatusEmpty: Staff consent status appears here after coaching is enabled. Each staff member's grant + revoke history is recorded.

settings.businessTypeAutoNote: AI classification categories will automatically adjust based on the business type.

settings.aiAutoOutreachDescription: Suggest follow-up messages for customers (coming soon).

voiceEnrollment.title: Enroll your voice (optional)
voiceEnrollment.description: Enrolling {name}'s voice slightly improves speaker recognition accuracy. Enrollment is optional — diarization works without it.
voiceEnrollment.privacyItem1: Recorded audio is converted to a voice embedding (256-dim vector); the raw audio is then discarded.
voiceEnrollment.privacyItem2: Embeddings are used only by the server-side diarization job; they're never sent back to the app.
voiceEnrollment.privacyItem3: Stored in encrypted storage compliant with Japan's Personal Information Protection Act (APPI).
voiceEnrollment.privacyItem4: Click 'delete' at any time to permanently remove your voice profile within 30 days.
voiceEnrollment.biometricNotice: Voice embeddings are classified as biometric data. Enrollment is fully voluntary — never required for work. Without enrollment, diarization still works via the 'first speaker = staff' heuristic.
voiceEnrollment.consentCheck: I understand the privacy conditions above and consent to enrolling my voice.
voiceEnrollment.recordInstruction: Please read the phrase below in your natural voice. Recording lasts ~15 seconds.
voiceEnrollment.phraseToRead: Thank you for visiting today. How are you feeling? Please let me know if anything feels off.
voiceEnrollment.readyHint: Tap the mic icon to start recording
voiceEnrollment.completeBody: {name}'s voice is enrolled. Speaker recognition will improve starting with your next session.
voiceEnrollment.revokeHint: You can delete your voice profile anytime in Settings > Staff > Voice Enrollment. After deletion, new sessions will use generic diarization.
